A '''battle''' at the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ord Mantell/Legends|Ord Mantell]] occurred between the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] and the remnants of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] in the months following the [[Battle of Dathomir (Hunt for Zsinj)|death]] of [[Warlord/Legends|Warlord]] [[Zsinj]] at [[Dathomir/Legends|Dathomir]] in [[8 ABY/Legends|8 ABY]]. As different Imperial factions [[Post–Zsinj campaigns|raced to claim]] [[Zsinj's Empire|Zsinj's territory]], [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Gial Ackbar/Legends|Gial Ackbar]] sent a task force into [[Imperial Space]] against the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ord Mantell/Legends|Ord Mantell]]. The strike was successful in bringing the world under New Republic control, and the task force moved onto [[Battle of Agamar (Galactic Civil War)|capture]] [[Agamar/Legends|Agamar]].<ref name="Atlas" />
